test_sql_injection_attempt.title: Verify login rejects SQL injection payload

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Login page > Security - Injection
steps.expected: Security - Injection page loads without errors

steps.action: Locate the form, input, or control where validation applies
steps.expected: The target input or form is visible

steps.action: Enter invalid data or trigger the error condition for SQL injection attempt
steps.expected: The invalid input is accepted into the field

steps.action: Attempt to submit or trigger the validation
steps.expected: Validation fires on submit or field blur

steps.action: Verify an error message is displayed near the field or at the top of the form
steps.expected: A clear, descriptive error message appears

steps.action: Verify the error message text is correct and helpful
steps.expected: Error message accurately describes the validation failure

steps.action: Verify the form did not submit or the action was blocked
steps.expected: No data was saved; the user remains on the form

steps.action: Correct the invalid input with valid data
steps.expected: The error message disappears when valid data is entered

steps.action: Set up precondition: on login
steps.expected: Precondition is met (on login)

steps.action: Submit with the corrected data and verify success
steps.expected: Form submits successfully after correction

test_xss_attempt.title: A script tag typed as the email is rejected with an error

steps.action: Type <script>alert('XSS')</script> as the email with any password and click Login.
steps.expected: The app does not sign in and an error message shows.

test_password_too_short.title: A three-character password does not log the user in

steps.action: Open the login page.
steps.expected: The Email and Password fields show.

steps.action: Enter user@example.com as the email and 123 as the password, then click Login.
steps.expected: The user is not logged in. The login page stays open or shows a validation message.

test_brute_force_protection.title: Verify brute force protection activates after repeated failures

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Login page > Login Security
steps.expected: Login Security page loads without errors

steps.action: Wait for the page to fully render
steps.expected: All page elements are loaded

steps.action: Locate the relevant UI area for brute force protection
steps.expected: The target section or element is visible

steps.action: Verify brute force protection is displayed and functions correctly
steps.expected: Brute force protection is displayed as expected (with multiple failed login attempts)

steps.action: Set up precondition: with multiple failed login attempts
steps.expected: Precondition is met (with multiple failed login attempts)

steps.action: Verify no errors or unexpected behavior occurred
steps.expected: Page remains stable with no console errors
